end.summary:
- Practised sorting wet waste into the green bin and dry waste into the blue bin; banana peel and leaves were identified as wet waste.
- Practised describing a compost pit and what happens to waste in it.
- Plastic was later placed with compost and described as becoming brown compost or mixing into soil; this mix-up was not corrected after the last time it appeared.
- Next time, check that they can separate compostable peels/leaves from plastic and explain that plastic does not rot into soil.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste and describing a compost pit. They correctly identified banana peel and leaves as wet waste, but later mixed plastic into the compost and said it would become part of the soil; this was not corrected after the last occurrence. At home, sort a few items together into wet/green, dry/blue, and “not for compost,” then ask why plastic does not belong in the compost pit.
